en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> used to even out the bed for my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> until he<sup>asws</sup> would come. So when he<sup>asws</sup> would lie down upon his<sup>asws</sup> bed and sleep, I<sup>asws</sup> would arise to go to my<sup>asws</sup> own bed. One night he<sup>asws</sup> was delayed, so I<sup>asws</sup> went over to the Masjid seeking him<sup>asws</sup>, and that was after the people had dispersed.

So there he<sup>asws</sup> was in the Masjid, prostrating, and there was no one in the Masjid apart from him<sup>asws</sup>, and I<sup>asws</sup> heard his<sup>asws</sup> yearning and he<sup>asws</sup> was saying:

‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! You<sup>azwj</sup> are my Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, truly, truly. I<sup>asws</sup> am prostrating to You<sup>azwj</sup>, O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, as a servant and a slave. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! My<sup>asws</sup> deeds are weak, so Increase these for me<sup>asws</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Save me<sup>asws</sup> (my<sup>asws</sup> Shias) from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Punishment on the Day You<sup>azwj</sup> will be Resurrecting Your<sup>azwj</sup> servants, and Turn towards me (with Mercy) for You<sup>azwj</sup> are the Oft-Turning, Merciful’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘I would prepare the bed for my father and wait for his coming until he would go to sleep; then I would leave to go to bed. One night he delayed and I went to the Masjid to search him. This was the time when people had already left and it was quite calm out there.
I found him in the Masjid prostrating and there was no one in the Masjid except him. I heard his affectionate plea saying,

“(O Lord,) You are free of all defects, You are my Lord, in all truth, there is no doubt. I have prostrated before You, my Lord as (Your) slave and a sole servant. O Lord, my deeds are weak, so please increase them for me. O Lord, save me from Your punishment on the Day when Your servants are resurrected and turn to me to accept my repentance. You accept repentance and grant mercy.’””
